decisions.reason: The cutting and creasing finisher is close to the core distributed portfolio, costs a wholesaler little to carry, and supports service and consumables revenue.
UV spot varnishing is distant from the core, but it is a recently premiered flagship enhancement line from a key supplier partner that needs more time to build sales.
The B2 multifinisher is a flagship that fits the firm's automation and digital finishing direction squarely.
The hybrid saddle stitcher serves the core booklet-making business for short-run digital printers, and nothing indicates it is underperforming.
The folding add-on unit has a documented customer installation and complements the existing Multigraf systems, so it is cheap to keep in the line.
